metadata.title: TriviaParty
metadata.description: A web-only trivia party game — phones as controllers, no install.

landing.tagline: Trivia for your group, in any browser.
landing.subtitle: One screen to share, phones as controllers. No app, no account — just a 4-letter code.

steps.title: How it works
steps.one: Open the game on a shared screen and create a room.
steps.two: Everyone scans the QR code or enters the 4-letter code on their phone.
steps.three: Answer fast, score big, and crown a winner.
